title: Route-level code split missing
summary: Single-page apps load admin, dashboard, or rarely used route code in the initial bundle.
rationale: Loading all route code up front increases first-load cost for users who never visit those routes.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Split by route and interaction boundary, prefetch selectively, and monitor real-user performance.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
